book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: كان في مرا بتحسب كل قرش.
sentences.en: There was a woman who counted every penny.
Her husband was a clerk with a limited salary.

sentences.ar: اشترت له شمسية غالية بعد نقاش طويل.
sentences.en: She bought him an expensive umbrella after a long argument.

sentences.ar: بعد شهر، رجع والشمسية فيها حروق زغيرة.
sentences.en: A month later, he came back with small burns in it.

sentences.ar: صارت تصرخ وهو بيحلف إنه ما بيعرف.
sentences.en: She started shouting and he swore he did not know how.
She said: your colleagues did it on purpose.
She went to the company that insured the house.

sentences.ar: قعدت قدام الموظف وحكت القصة كلها.
sentences.en: She sat before the clerk and told the whole story.

sentences.ar: الموظف حاول يفهم شو علاقة الشمسية بالحريق.
sentences.en: The clerk tried to understand what the umbrella had to do with a fire.

sentences.ar: بالآخر دفعوا لها عشان تسكت وتطلع.
sentences.en: In the end they paid her so she would be quiet and leave.

sentences.ar: طلعت وهي مبسوطة، ورجعت عالبيت تحسب.
sentences.en: She left pleased, and went home to count.
